lines.1: It's Friday night, so Otome has returned to her family home.
lines.3: This is how things turn out.
lines.6: 「I had trouble bringing this up... On Sunday, I'm meeting the man Mother plans to marry.」
lines.9: 「Yes. I've had plenty of time to prepare myself.」
lines.14: 「Despite everything, she still barely knows you.」
lines.16: It's true. I haven't shown my face.
lines.18: 「Mother said we could each show off our boyfriend. That would ease the tension and make it fun...」
lines.19: 「I can't tell whether your mother thinks big or is simply strange.」
lines.24: She probably wants me beside her when she meets him.
lines.25: Then I have to be there for her.
lines.26: And it really is time I introduced myself.
lines.28: We agreed to meet in front of Nagomi's house.
lines.30: I'm honestly grateful for that arrangement.
lines.34: 「Oh, Tennoji and Tsushima. You're both early.」
lines.37: 「So, Nodoka, don't I look more handsome than him when we're side by side?」
lines.41: They show every sign of becoming the obnoxious lovey-dovey couples I hate.
lines.43: 「Nagomi! I'm glad we're finally getting a chance to talk.」
lines.46: 「This town is famous for naval curry, right? That's what we're having today?」
lines.47: 「I've never tried it. I'm looking forward to this.」
lines.48: 「Then let's go. We can discuss the details at the restaurant. Nagomi picked a place she recommends.」
lines.49: 「Oh, this place has atmosphere. A representative restaurant of the Port Opening Festival.」
lines.51: We chat while waiting for the food.
lines.52: Soon the restaurant's recommended curry arrives.
lines.53: Kinu must be off work today.
lines.57: I take a bite of curry.
lines.60: 「Th-This is incredible... So this is the town specialty. I've been missing out.」
lines.63: 「That curry was prepared yesterday by Nagomi.」
lines.66: When did she find time to prepare all this?
lines.67: 「...I heard you had never tried this town's curry.」
lines.68: 「So, partly to apologize for refusing to listen until now, I put my full effort into it.」
lines.69: 「The ingredients here are excellent. I think it is one of my best efforts.」
lines.70: 「Wow. This is seriously good. And I got my wish to try Nagomi's cooking too. Two birds with one stone!」
lines.71: 「Honestly, I thought all curry was the same. This opened my eyes.」
lines.73: 「Yes. That's what I intend to do.」
lines.78: 「That place holds my memories with Dad.」
lines.81: 「Dad taught me the joy of making delicious food.」
lines.83: 「Of course I do. I've always told you to choose your own path.」
lines.84: 「You were the one fixated on the flower shop, Nagomi.」
lines.85: 「Because I don't want the shop Dad built to disappear.」
lines.86: 「Hey, don't erase it without asking me. What do you think I'm here for?」
lines.87: 「Tennoji says he'll leave his current job and help at the flower shop.」
lines.89: 「Become whatever you want, Nagomi. I'll support you too.」
lines.92: 「I won't object to you and Mother anymore. I approve of the marriage.」
lines.96: 「Don't worry. I couldn't forget him if I tried.」
lines.97: 「Your cooking tastes nostalgic. Even when I tried this curry, I thought I recognized it.」
lines.98: 「Your father taught you to cook. So I think he lives on in your cooking. I remember him each time I eat it.」
lines.100: 「Oh, right. I heard you sent all her father's things to your relatives?」
lines.101: 「I'm grateful you did it for me, but it seems cruel to Nagomi.」
lines.104: 「Then let's go home. I have something to show you.」
lines.109: Nodoka carries in a cardboard box.
lines.110: 「Dad's lighter, the photos... It's all here.」
lines.111: 「I'm sorry. I lied about leaving them with our relatives.」
lines.112: 「It hurt me too much to actually hand them over.」
lines.115: 「That secretly hurts you, doesn't it, old man?」
lines.118: 「Don't call me old! I'm your big brother!」
lines.119: 「...Well, I never intended to replace her father.」
lines.120: 「I'll make Nodoka happy in my own way, with what I can offer.」
lines.121: 「Look, Nagomi. This is from when we went to Atami with your father. You were only four.」
lines.123: Mother and daughter look happy before the keepsakes they haven't seen in so long.
lines.124: The two outsider men feel vaguely left out.
lines.125: I pat Tennoji on the shoulder.
lines.127: 「Sigh... If Nodoka and Nagomi are happy, that's enough for me.」
lines.128: 「That's what I want to say to sound cool! But even so, you know what I mean, right?!」
lines.132: 「Sure. This is a special occasion, so I'm buying.」
lines.135: The rooftop glows in the sunset.
lines.136: 「So this is where you were, Nagomi.」
lines.139: 「Three months ago, we were both up here complaining that we had no dreams.」
lines.141: 「But you made a real decision. Good for you.」
lines.143: 「Right. Little Nagomi is all grown up.」
lines.145: Getting irritated by that is exactly what makes her a child.
lines.146: 「I decided without consulting you... Did that upset you?」
lines.147: 「Why would it? If you chose your dream without hesitation, that's enough.」
lines.148: 「Becoming a chef won't change what we have.」
lines.150: 「No matter what I become, I'll always be yours, Senpai.」
lines.153: 「I may have found my dream too.」
lines.155: 「I'll tell you once I've worked it out.」
